routes.original_values: home_map_id, intro_task_id, intro_movie_id, successor_task_id, successor_card_effect_id, first_npc_id

creation.authorization: record policy revision and exact immutable route in the same transaction as the new role; consume once under its current login lease
creation.old_roles: no automatic chapter initialization from level, experience, wallet origin, or a growth-only creation profile; explicit migration required
creation.initial_task: offer and accept only the route intro root; activate before playback; do not complete it at creation
creation.task_sync: authorized type50 root uses ScenarioQuestInfo state0/value1=0/value2=0/npc_key=0 before its explicit SStartPlayCG; native tracker0 is normal and2 is failure, while activation timing and zero opaque values remain designed
creation.task_sync_correction: previous designed state2 was falsified by actual GUI and original160daa0 tracker; state0 corrects presentation only, without changing persisted chapter/route identity
creation.initial_level: use the existing designed L1 growth profile; original root MinLevel0 MaxLevel0 uses the existing uncapped-zero requirement semantics

spawn.requirements: startup validates map resource, signed16 logical bounds and mask1 walkability; initialize only fresh role without position; retain committed position on retries

chapter.identity: one durable chapter instance per role and creation provenance; independent of connection epoch
chapter.authorization: persist intro task/movie, selected successor, home map and exact policy/route fingerprint; active task and chapter must agree
chapter.playback: persist playback identity and current lease/connection generation; role owner holds only a frozen IntroTicket/location/version; each I/O transaction builds a local NewbieFlow through its public ticket-restoration Interface; emit only after first-world initialization
chapter.gameplay_gate: while intro playback is pending, admit only matching movie completion and connection control traffic; world movement, NPC writes, growth, item use and transfer wait
chapter.completion: matching CEndPlayCG validates current expected movie, epoch, generation, active root, location/version and deadline; complete root and activate only the selected original successor with reward receipts in one role transaction
chapter.resume: after disconnect or expired playback, keep root active and authorize a new playback under the next valid connection; completed chapters retain tasks and position without replay
chapter.timeout_effect: invalidate playback authorization and require reconnect or trusted explicit resume; never complete the task on timeout
chapter.receipt: stable chapter completion key across playback attempts; historical receipts acknowledge once and return current task/assets, never restore historical values

native_adapter.body: exactly one positive signed32 big-endian movie_id

intro_discriminator.source: SEnterWorld outer object +0x48/+0x4c, independent of real EXP +0xf8/+0xfc
intro_discriminator.client_condition: signed64 <= 0 enables intro gate; signed64 > 0 disables this entry gate
intro_discriminator.mapping_provenance: designed_local_projection; positive1 is not a proven original server completion value
intro_discriminator.legacy_without_chapter: retain existing compatibility behavior until explicit migration; do not infer completion from XP

native_adapter.temporary_cinematic_map: client movie Setmap/Return does not change authoritative role position; real quest teleports use the existing map handoff
native_adapter.wire_limits: CEnd has no task ID, playback nonce, epoch, version or termination cause; shared cleanup also emits it, so it is a completion declaration under current authorization and does not prove natural End or eliminate identical late replay
native_adapter.skip_policy: accept a valid matching authorized CEnd as completion; this is designed and does not claim a restored original skip rule

acceptance: all43 legal character/school combinations initialize their own original root and selected successor
fresh provenance activation and spawn are atomic, rollback leaves no partial chapter or task
unsolicited/wrong movie, old epoch, changed location/generation and expired playback refuse
completion, selected next task, rewards and receipt commit together; retries cannot repeat assets
reconnect pending chapter replays correctly; completed chapter preserves position/tasks and emits no intro
continuous native encrypted/compressed messages decode in the required initialization order
actual client naturally enters its school, plays intro, returns and can approach its first NPC; separately authorized GUI validation
